title: 基线 4.6 S-A: prepay 200, settle 600 + 400, receive 800 at 6.875, freight 650 → 390 + 260, result CNY 2,350 = 1,410 + 940
deviations: The plan's "receive 800 at 6.875 via an FX conversion record": STL's fx_conversion fund record cannot be applied (receipts only) and a same-currency receipt converted later is not attributable to the order's FX difference (C9's rule); so, as C8/C9 do, the bank's CNY credits (1,400.00 at 7.0; 5,500.00 at 6.875) are recorded as CNY receipts and applied at the settlement-purpose rates 0.142857142857 and 0.145454545455, which gives the baseline's −100.00.
Payment terms 20 % on order confirmation / 80 % 30 days after shipment (C9's; the baseline states only the 200 prepayment).
Net cash is CNY 2,900.00 (receipts 6,900 − purchase payments 4,000), not the baseline's 2,250.00: charges are not paid through STL (C9's reported gap); the freight's 650.00 payment is outside S5.

the external inspection agency's system: qc records the agency's report (an EVD file) as a fact
the carrier's and the forwarder's systems: the booking, the B/L record and the forwarder's bill are entered from EVD evidence
China customs (single window): the declaration's submission and receipt are recorded manually (CN-M01), the receipt's original text is synthetic
the bank: fund records are entered by treasury from synthetic bank advices
the tax authority: the VAT special invoice is a synthetic scan imported and verified by tax.officer; no refund is submitted, approved or received, the case stays expected
CLM: the order result records claims not_enabled (S5 has no claims context)
the Outbox relay to an external sink: the relay publishes to the in-process dispatcher (brant-worker -dispatch)
